user_period.description: Explicit user billing period; preserve meaning.
user_period.title: User Period

catalog_unit.description: Exact catalog unit equivalent to user_period, else null. No conversions/guesses.
catalog_unit.title: Catalog Unit

intent.description: Communicative purpose, separate from whether clarification is needed.
intent.title: Intent

ambiguity_level.description: Unresolved meaning; not an action threshold.
ambiguity_level.title: Ambiguity Level

target_items.description: Equipment actually requested or referred to; resolve only supported references.
target_items.title: Target Items

categories.description: Conceptual equipment categories, without a fixed catalog taxonomy.
categories.title: Categories

budget_max.description: Explicit maximum budget; null when absent or units cannot be interpreted.
budget_max.title: Budget Max

budget_period.description: Resolve the explicit user billing period against the canonical catalog units. Null when the user established no period.

intended_use.description: Relevant user-stated workload, after corrections; null if unknown.
intended_use.title: Intended Use

needs_external_search.description: Whether technical facts need external verification; shop prices, stock and policies need their authoritative source.
needs_external_search.title: Needs External Search

search_query.description: Focused technical verification query, or null when unnecessary.
search_query.title: Search Query

reference_resolution.description: Supported current referent, or absence of prior referent. Nonempty.
reference_resolution.title: Reference Resolution

decision_reason.description: Nonempty evidenced reason to answer or ask material pending questions.
decision_reason.title: Decision Reason

text.description: Original assistant invitation to pending questions; never echo the user. Natural ungendered Thai.
text.title: Text

value.description: Established text or quantitative JSON number; no punctuation placeholders. Omit unknown facts.
value.title: Value

response_mode.description: conversation: a social exchange or humorous/creative act, including playful equipment references without a factual rental request. information: an in-scope explanation or a scope refusal. Direct catalog price/detail requests require equipment evidence; an unknown authoritative fact is not a missing user preference.
response_mode.title: Response Mode

choices.description: All displayed options in one array, including the unrestricted option when applicable. At most four total.
choices.title: Choices

branches.description: Adapt to one earlier question: cover each source choice ID with relevant title/choices. Empty if independent or for unknown typed answers.
branches.title: Branches

choices.description: All displayed options in one array, including the unrestricted option when applicable. At most four total.
choices.title: Choices

label.description: Complete answer. Budget maximum: closed ceiling with billing period or explicitly unlimited; never a lower bound.
label.title: Label

value.description: Exact label meaning, including ceiling/absence of ceiling and billing period. Preserve distinctions between choices.
value.title: Value

choice_kind.description: specified establishes a preference or finite ceiling; unrestricted leaves that preference unconstrained. A maximum-budget question includes one unrestricted option explicitly removing the ceiling.
choice_kind.title: Choice Kind

speaker_register.description: Exact machine label. Use natural ungendered Thai in all assistant text.
speaker_register.title: Speaker Register

stage.description: Pending unknowns: clarification. Ready catalog: equipment; external verification: technical. Unfiltered browsing: catalog_overview. App evidence: documents. Non-catalog reply: conversation/information.
stage.title: Stage
